courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 分段鏡共相控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」與「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；分段鏡共相控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" and "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Segmented-mirror co-phasing control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦薄彎月主鏡的重力變形、模態剛性、軸向與側向支撐、低頻波前感測與力圖監測；分段鏡共相控制則以段鏡 piston 誤差的光學代價、邊緣感測器與致動器、2π 模糊、共相相機、設定點校正與段鏡更換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on gravity sag of thin meniscus primaries, modal stiffness, axial and lateral support, low-rate wavefront sensing and force-map monitoring; Segmented-mirror co-phasing control centres on optical cost of segment piston, edge sensors and actuators, 2π ambiguity, phasing cameras, set-point calibration and segment exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」與「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到分段鏡共相控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” and “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Segmented-mirror co-phasing control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
history.titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
history.text: 主動光學由 ESO 的 Raymond Wilson 在 1970 至 1980 年代系統化提出，1989 年拉西亞的 3.58 m 新技術望遠鏡（NTT）成為第一座以主動光學運轉的大型望遠鏡，證明薄而軟的主鏡可以由電腦控制的支撐力保持面形。1998 年起 VLT 的四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡沿用此概念，Gemini 與 Subaru 的 8 m 級彎月鏡也各自採用主動支撐，使 8 m 級單片主鏡成為可行。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Active optics was systematised by Raymond Wilson at ESO during the 1970s and 1980s, and in 1989 the 3.58 m New Technology Telescope (NTT) at La Silla became the first large telescope operated with active optics, proving that a thin, flexible primary can hold its figure through computer-controlled support forces. From 1998 the four 8.2 m VLT Unit Telescopes adopted the concept, and the 8 m class menisci of Gemini and Subaru also use active support, making monolithic 8 m primaries feasible. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」到「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" through "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
